BackgroundColorClass.helper: Optional. Choose a built-in Bootstrap or shared portal background color for the full-width section. Text contrast is handled for dark backgrounds.

CardBackgroundColorClass.helper: Choose a built-in Bootstrap or shared portal background color for the inner card. Text and secondary-action contrast are handled for dark backgrounds.

AnimationLevel.helper: Controls Porto reveal animation and the strength of hover, shadow, rounding, and click feedback. Reduced-motion preferences are always respected.

MarginBottom.helper: Optional. Controls spacing below this section.
